title: Auto-Fix: Missing GitHub Actions Workflow
pattern:
**Root Cause:** The error occurred because the `.github/workflows/main.yml` file was missing, leading to 404 errors when trying to run workflows. Additionally, Git issues arose due to uncommitted changes and untracked files.

**Fix:**
1. Created a basic GitHub Actions workflow file at `.github/workflows/main.yml`.
2. Staged all modified and untracked files using `git add`.
3. Committed the changes with an appropriate message using `git commit`.

This ensures that the CI/CD pipeline is correctly set up, and Git issues are resolved by properly staging and committing all necessary changes.

title: Modular Python Service Architecture
pattern:
To design a modular Python service, follow these steps:
1. Define a clear project structure with separate directories for different components.
2. Create an entry point file (`app.py`) that includes routers from different modules.
3. Use `requirements.txt` to manage dependencies.
4. Document the project roadmap and milestones in `ROADMAP.md`.

title: FastAPI Error Handling
pattern:
To handle errors in FastAPI:
1. Use `HTTPException` to raise exceptions with specific status codes and messages.
2. Check for conditions that may lead to errors (e.g., item not found) and raise appropriate exceptions.

title: FastAPI Basic CRUD Operations
pattern:
To implement basic CRUD operations in a FastAPI application:
1. Define data models using Pydantic.
2. Create an in-memory database simulation (e.g., a dictionary).
3. Implement `POST`, `GET`, `PUT`, and `DELETE` endpoints for the items.

title: File Preview & ZIP Export
pattern: Develop a file-preview modal/panel using Flask to render different file types and add a 1-Click ZIP Archive Export button using Python backend streaming.

title: Three.js Avatar Integration
pattern: To integrate stylized human avatar meshes with animations in a Three.js environment, load the GLB files and assign them to specific positions. Use event listeners for interactive elements like desks.

title: Self-Healing & Playbook Integration
pattern:
- Ensure all new frontend modules and backend routes compile cleanly.
- Update experience_ledger.jsonl and playbooks.json automatically.

title: Advanced File Studio & Multimodal Viewer
pattern:
- Develop a rich file-preview modal/panel in the Live Web IDE tab.
- Implement rendering capabilities for Images, Videos, Markdown, and HTML files.
- Add a 1-Click ZIP Archive Export button using Python backend streaming.

title: 3D Office Metahuman Simulation Upgrade
pattern:
- Use Three.js for 3D rendering and animation.
- Implement distinct desks, chairs, workstations, and animated states for each agent.
- Add interactive clickable desks with live camera, stream logs, and activity holograms.

title: Fix for SyntaxError: unexpected EOF while parsing
pattern: When encountering a `SyntaxError: unexpected EOF while parsing`, it typically indicates that there is an unclosed parenthesis or quotation mark in your code. Ensure all opening brackets and quotes have corresponding closing ones.

title: Python FastAPI Project Structure
pattern:
A typical Python FastAPI project structure includes:
- `app.py`: Main application file.
- `test_app.py`: Unit test file.
- `requirements.txt`: Dependency management file.
- `ROADMAP.md`: Project roadmap and milestones.

title: Standard Python File Verification
pattern: Always compile-check generated Python files using `python3 -m py_compile <file>` immediately after writing.
